title: Rajadhi Raja
desc: Raja, a rich estate owner's son, comes back from abroad in order to avenge his dead father. However, things get complicated when he is framed, and he finds his doppelgänger in his village.

title: Kaaval
desc: Anbu saves the life of his gangster friend, Karuna, from a police officer. However, a sudden turn of events leaves him running for survival when both the police and Karuna turn against him.

title: Mudhal Idam
desc: Mahesh, a thug, falls in love with Mythili, a student. However, her father who is a bus conductor disapproves of her relationship with Mahesh.

title: Thai Maaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.
